name: TWAP
summary: Market-set ceilings for time-sliced execution of vault funds; every slice routes through the hook stack.
behavior: Caps total and per-slice size, minimum interval (≥ 10 s), maximum duration and per-slice slippage (≤ 20%).
Slices are ordinary routed trades, so guards and rewards apply to them.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Configuration is enforceable today; the strategy vault that schedules slices is not yet deployed.
